text: Can you tell me about your sleep pattern and also how your energy has been during the day?

How much water do you typically drink during the day?
Do you use any blue-light filtering glasses or screen settings in the evening?
What has your blood pressure been running at home, if you've checked it?
Is there anything else going on in your life right now you'd like to tell me about?
Tell me more about how you've been feeling this past month.
What else has changed for you recently, besides the sleep?
How would you describe your mood lately?

Do you remember what you answered on the screening forms before this visit?
